desc:
🎣 Welcome to Northwoods Fishing! 🌲🐟

Explore the beautiful Northwoods and cast your line into the creek to catch a huge variety of fish! Hunt for Musky, Tiger Musky, Pike, Largemouth Bass, Smallmouth Bass, and much more!

🌊 **Fish in scenic creeks**
🐟 **Catch tons of different fish**
🎣 **Discover rare and exciting catches**
🔄 **Frequent updates and new content!**

🚨 **NEWLY RELEASED!** We're constantly working to improve the game and add new features, fish, rods and reels, and more!

👍 Like and favorite the game to support us and stay tuned for frequent updates!

Can you catch the biggest fish in the Northwoods?🌲🎣🐟
